notes: First science run of WISPDMX, a tunable 208 MHz HERA RF cavity haloscope searching for hidden photon dark matter (0.4 neV to 2.07 ueV). No exclusion-limit table is provided; numerical values are taken from the abstract/text: chi ~ 1e-13 within the resonant tuning ranges of the four cavity modes (TM010: 0.8602-0.8646 ueV, TE111: 1.3088-1.3358 ueV, TM020: 1.8820-1.8977 ueV) and chi ~ 1e-12 for the broadband range 0.2-2.07 ueV, with the limit steadily worsening below 0.2 ueV down to 0.4 neV (that rising portion not quantified in text, so not emitted). Values are order-of-magnitude from text, not digitized from Figs. 18/19, hence moderate extraction confidence. Assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, v_esc = 530 km/s; 95% CL.
